verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents hosting its APIs in the customer's own environment. Its docs cover GPU-accelerated and Kubernetes deployment paths, and the marketing site states it runs on device, on prem and in the cloud, so the core transcription product can be self-hosted. However, the evidence is only short doc headlines. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup documentation (container images, licensing and offline requirements), feature parity details versus the SaaS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Host our APIs in your environment, ensuring complete data privacy, infrastructure control
Deploy our APIs across Kubernetes clusters for elastic scaling, automated orchestration, and resilient operations.
Run our APIs on GPU-accelerated infrastructure for maximum throughput and lowest latency.
Run Speechmatics on device, on prem and in the cloud depending on your privacy needs.
